segments.title: Cold Open: Pepito Station Sign-On
segments.notes: Pepito delivers the top-of-hour broadcast sign-on as 'Pafita the dog' before handing off to Case Blackwell at the desk.

segments.title: Hype Train Freestyle Derailment
segments.notes: Hype Train commandeers the feed for a 25-month freestyle rap cycle, acknowledges subs, and expands his 'piss' mythology while Case attempts to enable discounted subscriptions.

segments.title: Trump-Putin Alaska Summit Coverage
segments.notes: Case and Hype Train watch and mock the Trump-Putin press conference from Alaska; minimal substantive news emerges, both leaders described as 'boring as shit' and '1 million years old.'

segments.title: Viewer Video Roulette: Kendall, Dating Game, Cops & Chuck E. Cheese
segments.notes: Case rates videos submitted via thecream.team: a Kendall-sent clip (poorly received), a 2010s dating-game sketch Case wrote for VEN, a police propaganda raid video, the 'running face man' compilation, a cat video, and a follow-up on the Chuck E. Cheese arrest in Tallahassee.

segments.title: Discounted Subs, Kendall's Outfit & New Sub Goal
segments.notes: Case enables discounted tier-one subs for three hours; Kendall models a matching hat-top-pants ensemble on camera; chat sets a new sub goal 'Learn how to DJ'; Kendall departs after a wave of gifted subs.

segments.title: Wire Roundup: Ice Cube Minecraft, Giant Humans, Disney Pop-Up, Kennedy Center, McKinsey AI, DC Guard, Robot Olympics, Penis Injury
segments.notes: Rapid-fire headlines: Ice Cube's 'ice cubicle' Minecraft ad; Missouri Rep. Eric Burlison claims Smithsonian hides giant-human/alien evidence; Disney 'Mickey & Friends' pop-up near Kendall's work; Wikipedia editor's decade-long campaign for neo-Nazi composer; Trump's Kennedy Center honoree picks; McKinsey AI existential-risk memo; Trump deploys National Guard to DC (Rolling Stone 'shock and awe' framing); Chinese robot Olympics; UK man with 14.5-inch penis breaks arm in shower.

segments.title: Butt Conspiracy Deep Dive (Guy Redacted)
segments.notes: Case adopts 'Guy Redacted' persona to investigate 'butts are fake' conspiracy via ultra-low-view YouTube videos (astral-projection Democrats contacting Ra, swamp-butt theory, head-butt semantics, 'never wipe' anthem).

segments.title: DJ C4 Studio Session: 'I've Got a Friend in Me' Rock Parody
segments.notes: Case and DJ C4 produce a vulgar rock parody of the Toy Story theme with vocalist Woody (Woodard), cycling through beats, keys, and lyric rewrites; final track played out as the broadcast raids Christine.

lore_notes.fact: Case's Oura ring reports a brain age of 1 million years due to nocturnal barrel-rolling sleep patterns.
Case rolls several miles per night in his sleep, describing it as a 'full barrel roll' and 'spin cycle.'
Case confirms he is divorced and avoids wearing the Oura ring during the day to avoid signaling availability.
Discounted tier-one subscriptions enabled for a three-hour window via Creator Dashboard.
New community sub goal set: 'Learn how to DJ' (performance focus, not production).
Kendelle physically present in studio wearing coordinated hat, top, and pants; matches Case's on-camera scale.
Broadcast concludes with a raid to Christine (channel not named per policy).

episode_summary: Barely Informed News opened with Pepito's canine sign-on and a marathon Hype Train freestyle before Case Blackwell dissected the substance-free Trump-Putin Alaska summit. The broadcast then cycled through viewer-submitted internet videos — including a poorly rated Kendall clip, a VEN dating-game sketch Case wrote, and a Chuck E. Cheese arrest follow-up — before enabling discounted subs and setting a 'Learn to DJ' goal. A wire roundup covered Ice Cube's Minecraft ad, a congressman's giant-human claims, Disney pop-ups, McKinsey AI anxiety, DC National Guard deployment, Chinese robot Olympics, and a 14.5-inch penis injury. The show closed with a 'butts are fake' conspiracy deep dive and a DJ C4 studio session producing a vulgar 'I've Got a Friend in Me' rock parody with vocalist Woody, ending on a raid to Christine.
